select:
SELECT * FROM acq_trml tt WHERE 1=1
and (REGEXP_LIKE(tt.carr_chip_manuf, '^[0-9]+$') or tt.carr_chip_manuf is null)
and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(tt.carr_chip_manuf, '[^0-9]+')
and REGEXP_LIKE(q.mgt_org_code, '[^0-9]+')

SELECT 'pap_r' || '~' || NVL(tt.pap_r, ' ') || ',' || 'rap_r' || '~' || NVL(tt.rap_r, ' ') || ',' || 'ia' || '~' || NVL(tt.ia, ' ') || ',' || 'ua' || '~' || NVL(tt.ua, ' ') AS str FROM acq_trml tt WHERE tt.asset_no = #{assetNo}

SELECT * FROM stat_data sd WHERE 1=1
and sd.data_date >= to_date(#{statDate} || '-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd') and sd.data_date < to_date(#{statDate} || '-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd') + interval '1' month
and sd.data_date >= to_date(#{statDate} || '-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd') and sd.data_date < to_date(#{statDate} || '-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd') + interval '1' year
SELECT * FROM task_data td WHERE td.stat_date = to_date(#{statDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND td.start_date >= to_date(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND td.end_date <= to_date(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
